learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain, understand, calculate, and evaluate the fundamental technical relationships, development goals, and functionalities of motor vehicles (cars, trucks) and their components. The focus is on vehicle longitudinal dynamics.
They know the driving resistances acting on a vehicle, the power requirement, the tractive effort available, and the driving limits due to traction.
Students can describe and analyze drivetrain components, their function, and structure.
Students are able to assess and compare the behavior of tires regarding their longitudinal dynamic properties.

syllabus_topics: Economic and ecological importance of the automobile
Driving resistances (rolling, air, acceleration, and gradient resistance)
Energy storage and energy conversion machines in motor vehicles
Characteristic converters (clutches, transmissions) for demand-oriented provision of driving forces
Brake systems, braking behavior and calculation of braking systems
Tire properties regarding vehicle longitudinal dynamics
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination and the laboratory practical as academic achievement. The grade is weighted by ECTS credits for the final grade.
